game.name: Cursed Crusade, The (Europe)
game.desc: The action takes place in the ancient world. Two warriors are about to embark on an adventure across Europe amid the clashes and battles of the 4th Crusade. Denz, a Templar, and Esteban, a mercenary, share the same motivation: to purge their souls of a terrible curse that afflicts them both. Embark on a quest spanning 5 chapters and 30 missions that will take you across medieval Europe. Use your demonic vision to increase your abilities at the expense of your humanity. Easy to learn, the graphics engine features over 90 combos, dozens of weapons and a time-counting system.
